Prepare cupcake crust ahead of time. Pack crust into bottom of cupcake liners and convection bake 8 minutes at 350F. Change oven to 300F after.

Cream the cream cheese and sugar together, add vanilla and optional flavoring (for example, 3 tbsp cocoa powder or 2 oz of espresso or 6 oz of berries). Mix in yolks one at a time.
